title: fix: simplify mobile sign-in layout
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Aligns the mobile sign-in text beside the menu and the larger GitHub button directly below it.
- Uses “Start building with Pollinations.” and tighter spacing between the text and button.

Validation: frontend build, Biome, and local responsive/dialog/navigation checks pass. TypeScript has the same five existing backend errors as unchanged main.

gist.headline: A tidier path into the hive
gist.blurb: The mobile sign-in banner makes a little more room for the important bit: a bigger GitHub button.
gist.summary: The mobile dashboard sign-in layout places “Start building with Pollinations.” beside the menu, with tighter spacing and a larger GitHub button directly below.
gist.impact: On mobile, the sign-in message sits beside the menu and the larger GitHub button is easier to spot and tap.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy pixel-art mobile dashboard with a compact menu, a short sign-in message, and a prominent GitHub button beneath it. Polli, wearing a tiny tool belt, adjusts the spacing while pixel flowers soften the scene.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel-art garden workspace, Polli adjusts a mobile dashboard screen with a compact menu and a large GitHub sign-in button, while code-plants bloom nearby against a prominent lime green (#ecf874) and soft pastel gradient background.
